turns.text: Hello - my account is AC-4471 and I have been charged twice for September.
The duplicate is 42.50, dated the 3rd.
Yes, please refund the duplicate.
Thank you. Can you confirm which account you refunded and how much?
Hi, account AC-4472. I want to check something before I renew.
My renewal date is the 14th - is that right?
Good. And the card ending 0114 is the one you will charge?
Then go ahead. Read back the account and the card you have for me.
Account AC-4473. I would like to stop my subscription.
It is the team plan, 96.00 a month.
No, I do not want the smaller plan. Cancel it now please.
Is it cancelled? Tell me the account and the amount you cancelled.
Account AC-4474 - I need last month's statement for our auditor.
Yes, send it to the address you have on file.
Which account did you send it for?
Hello - this is about AC-4475, a charge I do not recognise.
It is 7.99 and the reference says WKSP-2.
What is WKSP-2, and is it on the account I gave you?
All right, leave it for now. Just confirm what you have on file for me.
Account AC-4476. Two problems, both refunds, I am afraid.
The first is 64.25 - the seat we removed in July.
The second is separate: 18.00 of overage that was billed twice.
Yes, refund that one as well please.
Account AC-4477, and my invoice reference is INV-9903.
I only want to know whether the credit has been applied to it.
Sorry, I have asked this twice now - which invoice were we talking about?
